summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) using string-array rotation (`WV8StW` rotator) and hex-mangled identifiers over a large constant pool — an opaque payload whose behavior cannot be enumerated without dynamic tracing. The package's advertised purpose is CSS theme tokens; `dist/index.js` is a 20-line re-export of light/dark from `@servicetitan/tokens/core`. Fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated bundled sibling at install time is inconsistent with a theme-tokens library and evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code. The install-time execution path runs attacker-authored code on the installer's host as a consequence of `npm install`. The `@servicetitan` scope, homepage, and trivial theme re-export appear alongside the dropper in a shape consistent with a decoy wrapping the payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
